Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
